biological.citation: RAB17 promotes endometrial cancer progression by inhibiting TFRC-dependent ferroptosis (PMID: 39242574)
biological.summary: RAB17 suppresses ferroptosis in endometrial cancer cells by inhibiting transferrin receptor (TFRC) protein expression through ubiquitin proteasome-dependent degradation. RAB17 expression increases under low-glucose conditions and promotes EC cell survival during glucose deprivation via the RAB17-TFRC axis.

biological.citation: Single-cell RNA-seq and bulk-seq identify RAB17 as a potential regulator of angiogenesis by human dermal microvascular endothelial cells in diabetic foot ulcers (PMID: 37605780)
biological.summary: RAB17 expression is significantly reduced in HDMECs from diabetic foot ulcer patients compared to healthy controls. RAB17 overexpression enhances angiogenesis, HIF-1α and VEGF-A expression, and diabetic wound healing partially through the MAPK/ERK signaling pathway.

biological.citation: MAL2 and rab17 selectively redistribute invadopodia proteins to laterally-induced protrusions in hepatocellular carcinoma cells (PMID: 39813085)
biological.summary: RAB17 expression promotes actin- and cholesterol-dependent protrusions and selectively redistributes invadopodia proteins to protrusion tips in a GTP-dependent manner. RAB17 interacts with MAL2 in a GTP-dependent manner and redirects trafficking of newly synthesized membrane proteins from the Golgi to induced protrusions.

biological.citation: Downregulation of RAB17 have a poor prognosis in kidney renal clear cell carcinoma and its expression correlates with DNA methylation and immune infiltration (PMID: 37269962)
biological.summary: RAB17 is low-expressed in KIRC tissues and cell lines. Downregulation of RAB17 correlates with unfavorable clinicopathological characteristics and worse prognosis. Six CpG sites show higher DNA methylation in KIRC tissues with negative correlation to RAB17 mRNA expression. RAB17 expression is negatively correlated with immune cell infiltration.
biological.sample_size: KIRC tissues and normal tissues; cell lines

biological.citation: Downregulation of Rab17 promotes cell proliferation and invasion in non-small cell lung cancer through STAT3/HIF-1α/VEGF signaling (PMID: 31841274)
biological.summary: RAB17 knockdown promotes NSCLC cell proliferation, invasion, migration, and angiogenesis while suppressing apoptosis through activation of the STAT3/HIF-1α/VEGF pathway. RAB17 downregulation induces epithelial-mesenchymal transition (EMT) by decreasing E-cadherin and increasing Vimentin and β-catenin.

biological.citation: ALS2, the small GTPase Rab17-interacting protein, regulates maturation and sorting of Rab17-associated endosomes (PMID: 31959474)
biological.summary: RAB17 localizes primarily to recycling endosomes in a Rab11-dependent manner. ALS2 interacts with RAB17 and regulates maturation of Rab17-residing nascent endosomes to EEA1-positive early endosomes. RABGEF1 functions as a GEF for RAB17, while ALS2 acts downstream to regulate endosomal maturation without GEF activity.

biological.citation: LMO4 promotes OSCC progression by inducing RAB17 degradation and ferroptosis resistance (PMID: 41213908)
biological.summary: LMO4 promotes ubiquitin-proteasome-dependent degradation of RAB17 tumor suppressor in oral squamous cell carcinoma. LMO4-mediated RAB17 degradation enhances OSCC cell proliferation, migration, and ferroptosis resistance. RAB17 restoration reduces these malignant behaviors.
biological.sample_size: OSCC tissues and cell lines; nude mouse xenograft model

biological.citation: Rab17 regulates apical delivery of hepatic transcytotic vesicles (PMID: 30256711)
biological.summary: RAB17 is a monosumoylated protein that regulates basolateral-to-apical transcytosis in polarized hepatocytes. GTP-bound and sumoylated RAB17 are required for apical vesicle docking, and RAB17 GTP hydrolysis is required for vesicle delivery. RAB17 is a general component of transcytotic machinery for apically destined vesicle docking and fusion.

biological.citation: Rab17 inhibits the tumourigenic properties of hepatocellular carcinomas via the Erk pathway (PMID: 25707355)
biological.summary: RAB17 is reduced in HCC tissues (37.1% vs 64.6% in non-tumor tissue) and correlates with unfavorable variables including tumor size, differentiation, and metastases. RAB17 overexpression inhibits HCC cell proliferation, migration, and tumor growth while inducing G1 arrest. The anti-tumor effects are mediated through inhibition of the ERK pathway.

biological.citation: A proteomic approach to identify endosomal cargoes controlling cancer invasiveness (PMID: 28062852)
biological.summary: RAB17 knockdown selectively reduces cellular levels of Vamp8 (v-SNARE), which associates with RAB17 at late endosomes. RAB17 and Vamp8 regulate trafficking of neuropilin-2 (NRP2), a pro-invasive cargo. Reduced RAB17 or Vamp8 increases NRP2 cell surface expression and promotes transition from ductal carcinoma in situ to invasive phenotype.
